negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'набавки'/'тендери'/'добавувачи' or supplier-registration page was found on the websites of the systemic private MK banks (Комерцијална банка kb.com.mk, Стопанска банка stb.com.mk, НЛБ Банка nlb.mk, Халкбанк halkbank.mk, Шпаркасе Банка).
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted mk-language searches on each bank name plus набавка/тендер/оглас за понудувачи returned only employment ads (огласи за вработување), product notices and financial reports — no procurement notice board or vendor-onboarding form.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell hypothesis: private MK bank spend has no self-published tender channel, so the collection strategy must lean on IFI portals, gazette notices, trade press and financial disclosures instead of bank procurement pages.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific commercial aggregator was confirmed to actually carry private-sector (non-ESJN) bank RFPs.
negative_findings.result_summary: tenderi.mk, etenderi.mk, servisea.mk and the foreign aggregators all present themselves around јавни набавки/ESJN data; private coverage is claimed by macedoniatenders.com and j360.info but was not observable without a subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any budget spent on aggregator subscriptions should be gated on a coverage test, otherwise the run pays for re-listed public-portal data it already has.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetch of https://tenderi.mk/ returned empty content on one attempt.
negative_findings.result_summary: Single empty response; the domain appears in search results with live subpages (/tenders, /pricing).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treat as bot-defence or JS-rendered, not as dead; requires a browser-based or manual check in the verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank supplier-onboarding routes (vendor registration forms, e-sourcing tools such as SAP Ariba/Coupa instances used by parent groups OTP, NLB, Steiermärkische, Halkbank Türkiye, ProCredit Holding) were not located for the MK subsidiaries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search parent-group procurement domains and e-sourcing subdomains directly, and check group ESG/sustainability reports for supplier-portal links applicable to the MK entity.

coverage_gaps.description: Whether any aggregator genuinely indexes private-buyer RFPs in MK remains untested behind paywalls.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a controlled coverage test: take 3-5 known non-ESJN MK notices and check whether each aggregator lists them before committing to a subscription.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-web private notice channels — print/online newspaper classifieds (Нова Македонија, Слободен печат), LinkedIn posts by bank procurement staff, and bank ESG/annual-report supplier sections — were not covered in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a pass over MK newspaper oglasi sections and LinkedIn bank-procurement job titles to map the informal RFP route.

coverage_gaps.description: Local terminology for private-sector solicitation is unsettled: 'јавен повик' and 'оглас' are dominated by state and employment usage, making them very noisy for private procurement retrieval.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prefer narrower MK strings in future queries: 'барање за понуди', 'повик за доставување понуди', 'предквалификација на добавувачи', 'регистрација на добавувачи', 'тендерска документација' combined with bank names.

brief: North Macedonia's private banks publish essentially nothing about their own procurement: mk-language searches against Комерцијална, Стопанска, НЛБ, Халкбанк and Шпаркасе surfaced employment ads and product notices, but no 'набавки/тендери' board and no supplier-registration page. The traceable substitutes are therefore third-party: the EBRD Client eProcurement Portal (ECEPP), where private MK banks financed by EBRD must publish notices and awards, is the strongest single route; the Службен весник ТЕНДЕРИ section is the legally-published domestic fallback. Domestic aggregators (tenderi.mk, javnipovici.mk, mk.openprocurements.com, servisea.mk) and foreign resellers (macedoniatenders.com, tendersinfo, j360) mostly re-list ESJN data and their private-sector coverage claims need a paid-coverage test before being trusted. In the absence of tenders, vendor relationships become visible indirectly — through bankarstvo.mk and it.mk trade coverage, through Развојна банка's and the central bank's published procurement as category benchmarks, and through capex/supplier notes in bank filings on SEI-Net.
